description: Mints a prepaid key and a Checkout link for a human to pay by card, so later paid calls are debited from its balance instead of challenged. Call it when a call was refused for payment and your human prefers a card to a wallet; with a key already on the request it tops that key up instead. Do not call it to learn a price (use start_comparison with dryRun) or while the free allowance still covers the work. Example: { "amountUsd": 10 }. Free.

amountUsd.description: Whole US dollars to put on the key: one of the offered amounts (5, 10 or 25 by default).

name: request_prepaid_key
title: Request a prepaid key
